briefings.title: AI Dominates Economy and Markets with Torsten Slok | The Real Eisman Playbook Ep 68
briefings.tldr: The U.S. economy is currently buoyed by three non-interest-rate-sensitive "tailwinds"—AI spending, re-industrialization, and tax refunds—which are masking a severe K-shaped divergence and preventing the Federal Reserve from cutting rates.

briefings.title: Apollo's Private Credit Exposure: Chris Edson Weighs In | The Real Eisman Playbook Ep 57

people.name: Chris Edson
people.role: Partner and Global Head of Originations, Apollo

briefings.tldr: Chris Edson (Apollo) argues that the "private credit panic" is overblown by clarifying that the $40 trillion industry extends far beyond risky software buyouts into diversified, asset-backed lending, where Apollo maintains low software exposure and high capital alignment.
